mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5% for 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction signal over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a slowdown in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending economic deceleration, causing equity investors to reduce risk exposure and generate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1,000 thousand units, it signals strong consumer confidence and increased construction activity, which boosts corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates a strengthening labor market that supports higher consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion, a quarterly GDP level above 15,000 billion dollars (GDPC1) signals robust economic momentum that encourages equity investment and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during early-cycle expansion when GDPC1 > 15000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 235, it signals rising inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 235, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
